summary_md: **Siddhant Khare ([@Siddhant_K_code](https://x.com/Siddhant_K_code/status/2116593398660674014))** measured GitHub Copilot coding-agent traces: after 4–5 idle minutes 64% of the next prompt is still cached, but after 5–6 minutes only 26%, so long tool runs cost the same as idling ([Leave your coding agent for 5 minutes](https://siddhantkhare.com/writing/coding-agent-cache-five-minutes)).

referenced_urls.title: Leave your coding agent for 5 minutes and most of its cache is gone · Siddhant Khare

relevance: Prompt cache economics of agent loops.

media.description: Charts of cached share of prompt tokens versus idle time before a call in GitHub Copilot coding-agent traces, showing a sharp cliff at about 5 minutes and per-model differences.
